remainingOwnerAction: Create the FREE Render web service (Blueprint from render.yaml) and a dedicated Aiven MySQL Free database in your own dashboards, paste the MySQL credentials into Render only, then run `npm run verify:live -- --url https://<service>.onrender.com --expect-commit <sha>` and record the PASS report in a session file. Never paste credentials or payment information into chat.
